[size=5][b][color=#ffff00]     [/color][u][color=#00ff00]MOD DETAILS[/color][/u][/b]

[color=#ffff00]This mod adds Oxidizer, which will process tea leaves and dry fruits.[/color]

[color=#ffff00]This mod adds 2 crops and 8 trees.  Compatibility is already built in for other mods which add the same crops.[/color][/b]
